tickets.title: Canonical Research API and Persistence
validation: deterministic fixture import and idempotency scenario
acceptance_criteria: Layered ResearchCandidate, ResearchIdentifier, ResearchSource, ResearchDocument, and ResearchProvenance state is deterministic and explicit about unknown values.
Identifiers and local source hashes support duplicate detection, idempotent import, and conflict rejection.
Malformed metadata and unsafe paths fail before canonical mutation.
Provenance and source references survive persistence; derived metadata cannot overwrite canonical source state.
Baseline tests require no API key, paid provider, remote model, or OpenViking service.
tickets.description: Reusable deterministic research-domain API owns validation, normalization, identifier precedence, hashing, deduplication/conflict detection, provenance, and canonical persistence.

tickets.title: Research Operator Namespace and Manifests
acceptance_criteria: Existing kad-knowledge research namespace delegates domain behavior to the reusable research API.
DOI, arXiv, standard export, metadata, and local PDF workflows require no provider credentials.
Manifests support deterministic import/export but are not the sole mutation interface.
Unsafe paths, malformed input, duplicates, and conflicts produce deterministic non-success results without canonical corruption.
OpenViking absence does not prevent canonical import or exact source inspection.
tickets.description: Thin operator transport and supported manifest import/export for free/manual research workflows.

tickets.title: Provider Capability Profiles and Degradation
acceptance_criteria: Stable capability profiles are separate from dated availability/quota observations and economic admission.
Credential-free manifests represent manual/free/API/paid/unavailable constraint classes.
Missing, stale, unavailable, unauthorized, and quota-exhausted states reduce only the affected capability.
Explicit deterministic/local/manual/free fallback remains usable and paid lanes never activate implicitly.
Capability data cannot mutate canonical research authority.
tickets.description: Provider-neutral profiles, observations, and per-capability degradation behavior that preserve free/manual operation.

tickets.title: OpenViking Derived Research Context
validation: derived context trace and stale fallback scenario
acceptance_criteria: Derived resources use a stable KAD-bound research namespace keyed by ResearchDocument identity.
L0, L1, and bounded L2 preserve canonical IDs, source references, hashes, derivation version, and layer identity.
Original documents and authoritative source state remain outside OpenViking.
Hash/version mismatch marks derived context stale and requires rebuild.
Missing or stale OpenViking falls back to exact deterministic KAD/Librarian retrieval without canonical mutation.
tickets.description: Optional derived-context adapter with traceability, stale detection, rebuild, and exact fallback behavior.

tickets.title: Read-Only Zotero Local API Integration
validation: read-only loopback and export fallback scenario
acceptance_criteria: Documented Zotero Local HTTP API (localhost:23119/api/) is used without direct SQLite coupling or Zotero writes.
Adapter normalizes Zotero bibliographic metadata into ResearchCandidate and passes through canonical Research API.
Loopback-only network boundary is strictly enforced; arbitrary remote host overrides are rejected.
Zotero item keys remain provenance and cannot overwrite durable identifier precedence or canonical identity.
Zotero absence, connection refusal, or 403 degrades only Zotero capability while standard export/manual paths remain fully operational.
tickets.description: Optional read-only Zotero Local HTTP API adapter converting local bibliography items into canonical research candidates with permanent export fallback.
